blocks.en: We present a novel method for recovering world-grounded human motion from monocular video. The main challenge lies in the ambiguity of defining the world coordinate system, which varies between sequences. Previous approaches attempt to alleviate this issue by predicting relative motion in an autoregressive manner, but are prone to accumulating errors. Instead, we propose estimating human poses in a novel Gravity-View (GV) coordinate system, which is defined by the world gravity and the camera view direction. The proposed GV system is naturally gravity-aligned and uniquely defined for each video frame, largely reducing the ambiguity of learning image-pose mapping. The estimated poses can be transformed back to the world coordinate system using camera rotations, forming a global motion sequence. Additionally, the per-frame estimation avoids error accumulation in the autoregressive methods. Experiments on in-the-wild benchmarks demonstrate that our method recovers more realistic motion in both the camera space and

blocks.en: 1 INTRODUCTION
blocks.zh: 1 引言

blocks.en: World-Grounded Human Motion Recovery (HMR) aims to reconstruct continuous 3D human motion within a gravity-aware world coordinate system. Unlike conventional motion captured in the camera frame [Kanazawa et al. 2018], world-grounded motion is inherently suitable as foundational data for generative and physical models, such as text-to-motion generation [Guo et al. 2022; Tevet et al. 2023] and humanoid robot imitation learning [He et al. 2024]. In these applications, motion sequences must be high-quality and consistent in a gravity-aware world coordinate system.
blocks.zh: 世界坐标系下的人体运动恢复（HMR）旨在重力感知世界坐标系内重建连续的3D人体运动。与在相机参考系下捕获的传统运动[Kanazawa et al. 2018]不同，世界坐标系下的运动天然适合作为生成模型和物理模型的基础数据，例如文本驱动动作生成（text-to-motion generation）[Guo et al. 2022; Tevet et al. 2023]以及人形机器人动作模仿学习[He et al. 2024]。在这些应用中，运动序列在重力感知世界坐标系下必须保持高质量且一致。

blocks.en: Most existing HMR methods can recover promising camera-space human motion from videos [Kocabas et al. 2020; Shen et al. 2023; Wei et al. 2022]. To recover the global motion, a straightforward approach is to use camera poses [Teed et al. 2024] to transform camera-space motion to world-space. However, the results are not
blocks.zh: 大多数现有的HMR方法能够从视频中恢复出效果良好的相机空间人体运动[Kocabas et al. 2020; Shen et al. 2023; Wei et al. 2022]。为了恢复全局运动，一种直接的方法是利用相机位姿[Teed et al. 2024]将相机空间运动转换到世界空间。然而，其结果并不能

blocks.en: guaranteed to be gravity-aligned, and errors in translations and poses can accumulate over time, resulting in implausible global motion. Recent work, WHAM [Shin et al. 2024], attempts to recover global motion by autoregressively predicting relative global poses with RNN. While this method achieves significant improvements, it requires a good initialization and suffers from accumulated errors over long sequences, making it challenging to maintain consistency in the gravity direction. We believe the inherent challenge stems from the ambiguity in defining the world coordinate system. Given the world coordinate axes, any rotation around the gravity axis defines a valid gravity-aware world coordinate system.
blocks.zh: 保证与重力对齐，且平移和位姿上的误差会随时间累积，从而导致在物理上不合理的全局运动。最近的工作WHAM [Shin et al. 2024]尝试通过RNN以自回归方式预测相对全局位姿来恢复全局运动。虽然该方法取得了显著提升，但它需要良好的初始化，并且在长序列上面临累积误差的问题，导致难以在重力方向上保持一致性。我们认为，这一内在挑战源于定义世界坐标系的二义性。给定世界坐标系坐标轴后，绕重力轴的任意旋转都能定义一个有效的重力感知世界坐标系。

blocks.en: In this work, we propose GVHMR to estimate gravity-aware human poses for each frame and then compose them with gravity constraints to avoid accumulated errors in the gravity direction. This design is motivated by the observation that, for a person in any image, we humans are able to easily infer the gravity-aware human pose, as shown in Fig. 2. Additionally, given two consecutive frames, it is intuitively easier to estimate the 1-degree-of-freedom rotation around the gravity direction, compared to the full 3-degreeof-freedom rotation. Therefore, we propose a novel Gravity-View (GV) coordinate system, defined by the gravity and camera view directions. Using the GV system, we develop a network that predicts the gravity-aware human orientation. We also propose a recovery algorithm to estimate the relative rotation between GV systems, enabling us to align all frames into a consistent gravity-aware world coordinate system.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了GVHMR，用于估计每帧中重力感知的人体姿态，然后结合重力约束将它们组合起来，以避免重力方向上的累积误差。这一设计的灵感来自于如下观察：对于任何图像中的人物，人类都能够轻松推断出重力感知的人体姿态，如图2所示。此外，给定连续两帧，相比于完整的3自由度旋转，估计绕重力方向的1自由度旋转在直觉上更容易且更鲁棒。因此，我们提出了一种由重力方向和相机视线方向定义的新型重力-视线（GV）坐标系。基于GV系统，我们构建了一个预测重力感知人体朝向的网络。我们还提出了一种恢复算法来估计各GV系统之间的相对旋转，从而使我们能够将所有帧对齐到一个一致的重力感知世界坐标系中。

blocks.en: Thanks to the GV coordinates, we can process human rotations in parallel over time. We propose a transformer [Vaswani et al. 2017] model enhanced with Rotary Positional Embedding (RoPE) [Su et al. 2024] to directly regress the entire motion sequence. Compared to the commonly used absolute position encoding, RoPE better captures the relative relationships between video frames and handles long sequences more effectively. During inference, we introduce a mask to limit each frame’s receptive field, avoiding the complex sliding windows and enabling parallel inference for infinitely long sequences. Additionally, we predict stationary labels for hands and feet, which are used to refine foot sliding and global trajectories.
blocks.zh: 得益于GV坐标系，我们能够在时间维度上并行处理人体旋转。我们提出了一种利用旋转位置编码（RoPE）[Su et al. 2024]增强的Transformer [Vaswani et al. 2017]模型，来直接回归整个运动序列。与常用的绝对位置编码相比，RoPE能够更好地捕捉视频帧之间的相对关系，并更有效地处理长序列。在推理阶段，我们引入了一个掩码来限制每帧的感受野，从而避免了复杂的滑动窗口，并实现了无限长序列的并行推理。此外，我们还预测手部和足部的静止标签（stationary labels），用于优化足部滑动现象和全局轨迹。

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are threefold: 1. We propose a novel Gravity-View coordinate system and the global orientation recovery method to reduce the cumulative errors in the gravity direction. 2. We develop a Transformer model enhanced by RoPE to generalize to long sequences and improve motion estimation. 3. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach through extensive experiments, showing that it outperforms previous methods in both in-camera and world-grounded accuracy.
blocks.zh: 综上所述，我们的贡献主要有三点：1. 我们提出了一种新颖的重力-视线坐标系以及全局朝向恢复方法，以减少重力方向上的累积误差。2. 我们开发了一种经RoPE增强的Transformer模型，以泛化到长序列并改善运动估计。3. 我们通过大量的实验证明了该方法的有效性，表明它在相机参考系和世界坐标系精度上均优于以往的方法。

blocks.en: Camera-Space Human Motion Recovery. Recent studies in 3D human recovery predominantly use parametric human models such as SMPL [Loper et al. 2023; Pavlakos et al. 2019]. Given a single image or video, the target is to align the human mesh precisely with the 2D images. Early methods [Bogo et al. 2016; Pavlakos et al. 2019] employ optimization-based approaches by minimizing the reprojection error. Recently, regression-based methods [Goel et al. 2023; Kanazawa et al. 2018] trained on a large amount of data predict

Many efforts have been made to improve the accuracy by specialized design architectures [Li et al. 2023; Zhang et al. 2023], part-based reasoning [Kocabas et al. 2021a; Li et al. 2021], and incorporating camera parameters [Kocabas et al. 2021b; Li et al. 2022b]. HMR2.0 [Goel et al. 2023] designs a ViT architecture [Vaswani et al. 2017] and outperforms the previous methods. To utilize temporal cues, [Shi et al. 2020] uses deep networks to predict skeleton pose sequence directly from videos. To recover the human mesh, most methods build upon the HMR pipeline. [Kanazawa et al. 2019] adopts a convolutional encoder. [Choi et al. 2021; Kocabas et al. 2020; Luo et al. 2020] apply RNN successfully. [Sun et al. 2019] introduces self-attention to CNN. [Shen et al. 2023; Wan et al. 2021] employ a transformer encoder to extract temporal information.

blocks.en: Although these methods can accurately estimate human pose, their predictions are all in the camera-space. Consequently, when the camera moves, the human motion becomes physically implausible.
blocks.zh: 尽管这些方法能够准确估计人体姿态，但它们的预测结果均位于相机空间中。因此，当相机移动时，人体运动在物理上就会变得不合理。

blocks.en: World-Grounded Human Motion Recovery. Traditionally, estimating human motion in a gravity-aware world coordinate system requires additional floor plane calibration or gravity sensors. In multi camera capture systems [Huang et al. 2022; Ionescu et al. 2014], calibration boards are placed on the ground to reconstruct the ground plane and global scale. IMU-based methods [Kaufmann et al. 2023; von Marcard et al. 2018; Yi et al. 2021] use gyroscopes and accelerometers to estimate the gravity direction and then project human motion onto the gravity direction. Recently, researchers put efforts to estimate global human motion from a monocular video. [Yu et al. 2021] reconstructs human motion using physics law but requires a provided scene. Methods like [Li et al. 2022a; Yuan et al. 2022] predicts the global trajectory from locomotion cues. However, the camera motion and human motion are coupled, which make the results noisy. SLAHMR [Ye et al. 2023] and PACE [Kocabas et al. 2024] further integrate SLAM [Teed and Deng 2021; Teed et al. 2024] and pre-learned human motion priors [Rempe et al. 2021] in an optimization framework. Although these methods achieve promising results, the optimization process is time-consuming and faces convergence issues with long video sequences. Furthermore, these methods do not obtain gravity-aligned human motion.
blocks.zh: 世界坐标系下的人体运动恢复。传统上，在重力感知世界坐标系中估计人体运动需要额外的地面标定或重力传感器。在多相机采集系统[Huang et al. 2022; Ionescu et al. 2014]中，标定板被放置在地面上以重建地面和全局尺度。基于IMU的方法[Kaufmann et al. 2023; von Marcard et al. 2018; Yi et al. 2021]使用陀螺仪和加速度计来估计重力方向，然后将人体运动投影到重力方向上。近年来，研究人员致力于从单目视频中估计全局人体运动。[Yu et al. 2021]利用物理规律重建人体运动，但需要提供预先已知的场景。[Li et al. 2022a; Yuan et al. 2022]等方法通过步态运动线索来预测全局轨迹。然而，相机运动与人体运动相互耦合，导致结果充满噪声。SLAHMR [Ye et al. 2023]和PACE [Kocabas et al. 2024]在一个优化框架中进一步结合了SLAM [Teed and Deng 2021; Teed et al. 2024]和预学习的人体运动先验[Rempe et al. 2021]。尽管这些方法取得了不错的结果，但优化过程非常耗时，且在长视频序列上面临收敛困难的问题。此外，这些方法未能获得与重力对齐的人体运动。

blocks.en: Fig. 3. Overview of the proposed framework. Given a monocular video (left), following WHAM [Shin et al. 2024], GVHMR preprocesses the video by tracking the human bounding box, detecting 2D keypoints, extracting image features, and estimating camera relative rotation using visual odometry or a gyroscope. GVHMR then fuses these features into per-frame tokens, which are processed with a relative transformer and multitask MLPs. The outputs include: (1) intermediate representations (middle), i.e. human orientation in the Gravity-View coordinate system, root velocity in the SMPL coordinate system, and the stationary probability for predefined joints; and (2) camera frame SMPL parameters (right-top). Finally, the global trajectory (right-bottom) is recovered by transforming the intermediate representations to the world coordinate system, as described in Sec. 3.1.
blocks.zh: 图3. 所提出框架的概览。给定单目视频（左），遵循WHAM [Shin et al. 2024]，GVHMR通过跟踪人体边界框、检测2D关键点、提取图像特征，并利用视觉里程计或陀螺仪估计相机相对旋转来对视频进行预处理。GVHMR随后将这些特征融合为逐帧token，并通过相对Transformer和多任务MLP进行处理。输出包括：(1) 中间表示（中），即重力-视线坐标系下的人体朝向、SMPL坐标系下的根节点速度，以及预定义关节的静止概率；(2) 相机参考系下的SMPL参数（右上）。最后，如第3.1节所述，通过将中间表示转换到世界坐标系来恢复全局轨迹（右下）。

blocks.en: accumulation. Two concurrent works also focus on world-grounded human motion recovery. WHAC [Yin et al. 2024] uses visual odometry [Teed et al. 2024] to transform camera coordinate results to a world coordinate system and relies on another network to refine global trajectory. TRAM [Wang et al. 2024] employs SLAM [Teed and Deng 2021] to recover camera motion and uses the scene background to derive the motion scale. They also transform the camera coordinate results into a world coordinate system. In contrast to their methods, GVHMR does not require additional refinement networks and can directly predict the world-grounded human motion.
blocks.zh: 累积而导致性能下降。两项同期工作同样聚焦于世界坐标系下的人体运动恢复。WHAC [Yin et al. 2024]使用视觉里程计[Teed et al. 2024]将相机坐标系下的结果转换到世界坐标系，并依赖另一个网络来优化全局轨迹。TRAM [Wang et al. 2024]采用SLAM [Teed and Deng 2021]来恢复相机运动，并利用场景背景来推导运动尺度。他们同样将相机坐标系下的结果转换到世界坐标系中。与这些方法相比，GVHMR不需要额外的优化网络，能够直接预测世界坐标系下的人体运动。

blocks.en: 3.1 Global Trajectory Representation
blocks.zh: 3.1 全局轨迹表示

blocks.en: Global human trajectory {Γ 𝑤𝑡 ,𝜏𝑤𝑡 } refers to the transformation from SMPL space to the gravity-aware world space 𝑊 . However, the definition of 𝑊 varies, as any rotation of 𝑊 around the gravity direction is valid, leading to different Γ 𝑤 and 𝜏𝑤 . We propose to first recover a gravity-aware human pose for each image, then transform these poses to a consistent global trajectory. This approach is inspired by the observation that humans can easily infer the orientation and gravity direction of a person in an image. And for consecutive frames, estimating the relative rotation around the gravity direction is intuitively easier and more robust.
blocks.zh: 全局人体轨迹 {Γ 𝑤𝑡 ,𝜏𝑤𝑡 } 指的是从 SMPL 空间到重力感知世界空间 𝑊 的变换。然而，𝑊 的定义各不相同，因为 𝑊 绕重力方向的任意旋转都是有效的，从而导致不同的 Γ 𝑤 和 𝜏𝑤。我们提议首先为每张图像恢复出重力感知的人体姿态，然后将这些姿态转换为一致的全局轨迹。该方法的灵感来自于以下观察：人类能够轻易推断出图像中人物的朝向和重力方向。而对于连续帧，估计绕重力方向的相对旋转在直觉上更容易且更鲁棒。

blocks.en: Specifically, for each image, we use the world gravity direction and the camera’s view direction (i.e., the normal vector of the image plane) to define Gravity-View (GV) Coordinates. The proposed new GV coordinate system is mainly used to resolve the rotation ambiguity, so we only predict the per-frame human orientation Γ 𝐺𝑉𝑡 relative to the GV system. When the camera moves, we compute the relative rotation between the GV systems of two adjacent frames with relative camera rotations 𝑅𝑡 Δ, thus transforming all Γ 𝐺𝑉𝑡to a consistent gravity-aware global space. For global translation, following [Rempe et al. 2021; Shin et al. 2024], we predict the human displacement in the SMPL coordinate system from time 𝑡 to 𝑡 + 1, and finally roll out in the aforementioned world reference frame.
blocks.zh: 具体而言，对于每张图像，我们利用世界重力方向和相机的视线方向（即图像平面的法向量）来定义重力-视线（GV）坐标系。所提出的新GV坐标系主要用于消除旋转的二义性，因此我们仅预测相对于GV系统的逐帧人体朝向 Γ 𝐺𝑉𝑡。当相机移动时，我们利用相对相机旋转 𝑅𝑡 Δ 计算相邻两帧的GV系统之间的相对旋转，从而将所有 Γ 𝐺𝑉𝑡 转换到一个一致的重力感知全局空间中。对于全局平移，遵循[Rempe et al. 2021; Shin et al. 2024]，我们预测从时刻 𝑡 到 𝑡 + 1 人体在SMPL坐标系下的位移，并最终在上述世界参考系中进行轨迹展开（rollout）。

blocks.en: The human orientation in the GV coordinate system is well-suited for deep network learning, given that the establishment of the GV coordinate system is determined from the input images. It also ensures that the learned global orientation is naturally gravity-aware. We have also found this approach beneficial for learning local pose and shape, as demonstrated in the ablation study Tab. 3. In the rotation recovery algorithm between GV systems, we utilize the consistency of the y-axis in the GV system to systematically avoid cumulative errors in the gravity direction. This also mitigates potential errors in camera rotation estimation, resulting in our method achieving similar results under both GT Gyro and DPVO estimated relative camera rotations, as shown in Tab. 1. Compared to WHAM, our method does not require initialization and can predict in parallel without the need for autoregressive prediction.
blocks.zh: GV 坐标系中的人体朝向非常适合深度网络学习，因为 GV 坐标系的建立直接由输入图像确定。这还确保了所学得的全局朝向天然具备重力感知能力。我们还发现该方法有利于学习局部姿态和体型，如消融实验 Tab. 3 所示。在 GV 系统间的旋转恢复算法中，我们利用 GV 系统中 y 轴的一致性，系统性地避免了重力方向上的累积误差。这也缓解了相机旋转估计中的潜在误差，使得我们的方法在真实陀螺仪数据（GT Gyro）和 DPVO 估计的相对相机旋转下均能取得相似的结果，如 Tab. 1 所示。与 WHAM 相比，我们的方法不需要初始化，且无需自回归预测即可进行并行预测。

blocks.en: 3.2 Network Design
blocks.zh: 3.2 网络设计

blocks.en: Input and preprocessing. The network design is shown in Fig. 6. Inspired by WHAM [Shin et al. 2024], we first preprocess the input video into four types of features: bounding boxes[Jocher et al. 2023; Li et al. 2022b], 2D keypoints [Xu et al. 2022], image features [Goel et al. 2023], and relative camera rotations [Teed et al. 2024]. Then, in the early-fusion module, we use individual MLPs to map these features to the same dimension. These vectors are then element-wise added to obtain per-frame tokens { 𝑓 token𝑡∈R512}. These tokens are processed by a Relative Transformer, where we introduce rotary positional encoding (RoPE) [Su et al. 2024] to enable the network to focus on relative position features. Additionally, we implement a receptive-field-limited attention mask to improve the network’s generalization ability when testing on long sequences.
blocks.zh: 输入与预处理。网络设计如图 6 所示。受 WHAM [Shin et al. 2024] 的启发，我们首先将输入视频预处理为四类特征：边界框 [Jocher et al. 2023; Li et al. 2022b]、2D 关键点 [Xu et al. 2022]、图像特征 [Goel et al. 2023] 以及相对相机旋转 [Teed et al. 2024]。随后，在早期融合模块中，我们使用各自独立的 MLP 将这些特征映射至相同维度。接着将这些向量按元素相加，得到逐帧 token { 𝑓 token𝑡∈R512}。这些 token 由 Relative Transformer 处理，其中我们引入了旋转位置编码（RoPE）[Su et al. 2024]，以使网络能够聚焦于相对位置特征。此外，我们实现了一个感受野受限的注意力掩码，以提高网络在长序列测试时的泛化能力。

blocks.en: Rotary positional embedding. Absolute positional embedding is a common approach for transformer architectures in human motion modeling. However, this implicitly reduces the model’s ability to generalize to long sequences because the model is not trained on positional encodings beyond the training length. We argue that the absolute position of human motions is ambiguous (e.g., the start of a motion sequence can be arbitrary). In contrast, the relative position is well-defined and can be easily learned.
blocks.zh: 旋转位置嵌入。绝对位置嵌入是人体运动建模中 Transformer 架构的常用方法。然而，这会隐式降低模型向长序列泛化的能力，因为模型并未在超出训练长度的位置编码上进行过训练。我们认为，人体运动的绝对位置具有歧义性（例如，动作序列的起始点可以是任意的）。相比之下，相对位置定义明确且更易于学习。

blocks.en: Network outputs. After the relative transformer, the 𝑓 token′are processed by multitask MLPs to predict multiple targets, including the weak-perspective camera parameters 𝑐𝑤 , the human orientation in the camera frame Γ 𝑐 , the SMPL local pose 𝜃 , the SMPL shape 𝛽 , the stationary label 𝑝 𝑗 , the global trajectory representation Γ 𝐺𝑉 and 𝑣𝑟𝑜𝑜𝑡 . To get the camera-frame human motion, we follow the standard CLIFF [Li et al. 2022b] to transform the weak-perspective camera to full-perspective. For the world-grounded human motion, we recover the global trajectory as described in Sec. 3.1.
blocks.zh: 网络输出。经过 Relative Transformer 之后，𝑓 token′ 由多任务 MLP 进行处理，以预测多个目标，包括弱透视相机参数 𝑐𝑤、相机坐标系下的人体朝向 Γ 𝑐、SMPL 局部姿态 𝜃、SMPL 体型 𝛽、静止标签 𝑝 𝑗，以及全局轨迹表示 Γ 𝐺𝑉 和 𝑣𝑟𝑜𝑜𝑡。为了获得相机坐标系下的人体运动，我们遵循标准 CLIFF [Li et al. 2022b] 的方法将弱透视相机模型转换为全透视模型。对于世界基准的人体运动，我们按照 3.1 节所述恢复全局轨迹。

blocks.en: Post-processing. The proposed network learns smooth and realistic global movement from the training data. Inspired by WHAM, we additionally predict joint stationary probabilities to further refine the global motion. Specifically, we predict the stationary probabilities for the hands, toes, and heels, and then update the global translation frame-by-frame to ensure that the static joints remain at fixed points in space as much as possible. After updating the global translation, we calculate the fine-grained stationary positions for each joint (see the algorithm in the supplementary). These target joint positions are then passed into an inverse kinematics process to solve the local poses, mitigating physically implausible effects like foot-sliding. We use a CCD-based IK solver [Aristidou and Lasenby 2011] with an efficient implementation [Starke et al. 2019].
blocks.zh: 后处理。所提出的网络能够从训练数据中学习到平滑且逼真的全局运动。受 WHAM 的启发，我们额外预测关节静止概率以进一步细化全局运动。具体而言，我们预测双手、脚趾和脚跟的静止概率，然后逐帧更新全局平移，以确保静止关节尽可能保持在空间中的固定位置。在更新全局平移后，我们计算每个关节的高精度静止位置（参见补充材料中的算法）。随后，将这些目标关节位置送入逆运动学（IK）过程中解算局部姿态，从而减轻诸如滑步等不符合物理真实性的现象。我们采用了基于 CCD 的 IK 求解器 [Aristidou and Lasenby 2011] 及其高效实现 [Starke et al. 2019]。

blocks.en: Losses. We use the following losses for training: Mean Squared Error (MSE) loss on predicted targets except for stationary probability, which uses Binary Cross-Entropy (BCE) loss. Additionally, we use L2 loss on 3D joints, 2D joints, vertices, translation in the camera frame, and translation in the world coordinate system. More details are provided in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh: 损失函数。我们在训练中使用以下损失函数：除静止概率使用二值交叉熵（BCE）损失外，对其余预测目标均采用均方误差（MSE）损失。此外，我们对 3D 关节、2D 关键点、网格顶点、相机坐标系下的平移以及世界坐标系下的平移使用 L2 损失。更多细节见补充材料。

blocks.en: 3.3 Implementation details
blocks.zh: 3.3 实现细节

blocks.en: GVHMR has 12 layers of transformer encoder. Each attention unit has 8 heads. The hidden dimension is 512. The MLP has two linear layers with GELU activation. GVHMR is trained from scratch on a mixed dataset consisting of AMASS [Mahmood et al. 2019], BEDLAM [Black et al. 2023], H36M [Ionescu et al. 2014], and 3DPW [von Marcard et al. 2018]. During training, we augment the 2D keypoints following WHAM. For AMASS, we simulate static and dynamic camera trajectories, generate bounding boxes, normalize the keypoints using these boxes from -1 to 1, and set image features to zero. For other datasets that come with videos, we extract image features using a fixed encoder [Goel et al. 2023]. The training sequence length is set to 𝐿 = 120. The model converges after 500 epochs with a batch size of 256. Training takes 13 hours on 2 RTX 4090 GPUs.
blocks.zh: GVHMR 包含 12 层 Transformer 编码器。每个注意力单元有 8 个头。隐藏层维度为 512。MLP 包含两个带有 GELU 激活函数的线性层。GVHMR 在包含 AMASS [Mahmood et al. 2019]、BEDLAM [Black et al. 2023]、H36M [Ionescu et al. 2014] 和 3DPW [von Marcard et al. 2018] 的混合数据集上从零开始训练。训练期间，我们遵循 WHAM 对 2D 关键点进行数据增强。对于 AMASS，我们模拟静态和动态相机轨迹，生成边界框，并使用这些边界框将关键点归一化至 -1 到 1 之间，同时将图像特征置零。对于自带视频的其他数据集，我们使用固定的编码器 [Goel et al. 2023] 提取图像特征。训练序列长度设置为 𝐿 = 120。在批大小为 256 的情况下，模型在 500 个 epoch 后收敛。在 2 块 RTX 4090 GPU 上的训练耗时 13 小时。

blocks.en: Metrics. We follow the evaluation protocol of [Shin et al. 2024; Ye et al. 2023], using the code released by WHAM to apply FlipEval for test-time augmentation and evaluate our model’s performance. To compute world-coordinate metrics, we divide the predicted global sequences into shorter segments of 100 frames and align each segment to the ground-truth segment. When the alignment is performed using the entire segment, we report the World-aligned Mean Per Joint Position Error (WA-MPJPE100). When the alignment is performed using the first two frames, we report the World MPJPE (W-MPJPE100). Additionally, to assess the error over the global motion, we evaluate the whole sequence for Root Translation Error (RTE, in %), motion jittery (Jitter, in 𝑚 / 𝑠3 ), and foot sliding (FS, in 𝑚𝑚 ). The camera-coordinate metrics include the widely used MPJPE, Procrustes-aligned MPJPE (PA-MPJPE), Per Vertex Error (PVE), and Acceleration error (Accel, in 𝑚 / 𝑠2 ) [Goel et al. 2023; Li et al. 2022b; Shin et al. 2024; Ye et al. 2023].
blocks.zh: 评估指标。我们遵循 [Shin et al. 2024; Ye et al. 2023] 的评估协议，使用 WHAM 发布的开源代码应用 FlipEval 进行测试时增强，并评估我们模型的性能。为了计算世界坐标系指标，我们将预测的全局序列划分为 100 帧的较短片段，并将每个片段与真实值片段进行对齐。当使用整个片段进行对齐时，我们汇报世界坐标对齐的平均每关节位置误差（WA-MPJPE100）。当仅使用前两帧进行对齐时，我们汇报世界坐标 MPJPE（W-MPJPE100）。此外，为了评估全局运动的误差，我们针对整个序列评估根关节平移误差（RTE，单位为 %）、运动抖动（Jitter，单位为 𝑚 / 𝑠3 ）以及滑步（FS，单位为 𝑚𝑚 ）。相机坐标系指标包括广泛使用的 MPJPE、Procrustes 对齐的 MPJPE（PA-MPJPE）、逐顶点误差（PVE）和加速度误差（Accel，单位为 𝑚 / 𝑠2 ）[Goel et al. 2023; Li et al. 2022b; Shin et al. 2024; Ye et al. 2023]。

blocks.en: 4.3 Comparison on Camera Space Motion Recovery
blocks.zh: 4.3 相机空间运动恢复对比

blocks.en: We compare our method with state-of-the-art motion recovery methods that predict camera-space results. The results are shown in Tab. 2, where our method achieves the best performance on most of the metrics with a clear margin, demonstrating the effectiveness of our method in camera-space motion recovery. We attribute this to the multitask learning strategy that enables our model to use global motion information to improve the camera-space motion estimation, especially the shape and smoothness of the motion. Our PA-MPJPE performance is slightly behind WHAM by 0.3 mm on the 3DPW dataset. This may be due to the fact that we do not directly predict the SMPL parameters, but rather the SMPLX parameters, which might introduce some errors. Nevertheless, the numbers are still competitive. Fig. 8 demonstrates that our approach estimates human motion in the camera space more accurately than WHAM.
blocks.zh: 我们将本方法与预测相机空间结果的现有最先进运动恢复方法进行了对比。结果如 Tab. 2 所示，我们的方法以明显优势在绝大多数指标上均取得了最优性能，充分证明了本方法在相机空间运动恢复中的有效性。我们将此归功于多任务学习策略，该策略使我们的模型能够利用全局运动信息来改善相机空间运动估计，特别是运动的形态与平滑度。在 3DPW 数据集上，我们的 PA-MPJPE 表现仅落后 WHAM 0.3 mm。这可能是因为我们并未直接预测 SMPL 参数，而是预测 SMPLX 参数，从而可能引入了一定误差。尽管如此，该指标数值依然极具竞争力。图 8 表明，我们的方法在相机空间中对人体运动的估计比 WHAM 更为精确。

blocks.en: 4.4 Understanding GVHMR
blocks.zh: 4.4 深入理解 GVHMR

blocks.en: Ablation Studies. To understand the impact of each component in our method, we evaluate seven variants of GVHMR using the same training and evaluation protocol on the RICH dataset. The results are shown in Tab. 3: (1) w/o 𝐺𝑉 : when predicting human motion solely in the camera coordinate system, the metrics drop slightly. This suggests that gravity alignment improves camera-space human motion estimation accuracy. For this variant, we can further recover a non-gravity-aligned global motion, which performs poorly in global metrics. (2) w/o Γ 𝐺𝑉 : when predicting the relative global orientation from frame to frame, the world-coordinate metrics drop substantially, indicating that the model suffers from error accumulation in this configuration. blocks.en: Running Time. We test the running time with an example video of 1430 frames (approximately 45 seconds). The preprocessing, which includes YOLOv8 detection, ViTPose, Vit feature extraction, and DPVO, takes a total of 46.0 seconds (4 . 9 + 20 . 0 + 10 . 1 + 11 . 0). The rest of the GVHMR takes 0.28 seconds. WHAM adopts the same preprocessing procedures, and it requires 2.0 seconds for the core network. The optimization-based method SLAHMR takes more than 6 hours to process. All models are tested with an RTX 4090 GPU. The improved efficiency enables scalable processing of human motion videos, aiding in the creation of foundational datasets.

blocks.en: 5 CONCLUSIONS
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduce GVHMR , a novel approach for regressing worldgrounded human motion from monocular videos. GVHMR defines a Gravity-View (GV) coordinate system to leverage gravity priors and constraints, avoiding error accumulation along the gravity axis. By incorporating a relative transformer with RoPE, GVHMR handles sequences of arbitrary length during inference, without the need for sliding-window. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GVHMR outperforms existing methods across various benchmarks, achieving state-of-the-art accuracy and motion plausibility in both cameraspace and world-grounded metrics.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了 GVHMR，一种从单目视频中回归世界坐标系人体运动的新方法。GVHMR 定义了重力-视角（GV）坐标系以利用重力先验与约束，从而避免沿重力轴的误差累积。通过将带有 RoPE 的相对 Transformer 相结合，GVHMR 在推理期间能够处理任意长度的序列，而无需滑动窗口。大量实验表明，GVHMR 在各类基准上均优于现有方法，在相机空间与世界坐标系指标上均取得了当前最优的精度和运动合理性。
